classes/arcane-archer-378.name: Arcane Archer
classes/arcane-archer-378.proficiencyText: An arcane archer is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor, medium armor, and shields.

proficiencyReview.note: Exact Dungeon Master's Guide v.3.5 training grant verified against the class feature text.

levelGrants.name: Enhance Arrow
levelGrants.description: Every nonmagical arrow the arcane archer nocks and fires becomes magical for her, gaining a +1 enhancement bonus at 1st level. The bonus improves to +2 at 3rd level, +3 at 5th, +4 at 7th, and +5 at 9th; these arrows function as enhanced arrows only for the arcane archer.

levelGrants.name: Imbue Arrow
levelGrants.description: Place an area spell upon an arrow and fire it as part of the same standard action. The spell's area is centered where the arrow lands, allowing the bow's range to replace the spell's normal range; the arrow must be fired in the round the spell is cast or the spell is wasted.

levelGrants.name: Enhance Arrow
levelGrants.description: Enhance Arrow improves to a +2 enhancement bonus.

levelGrants.name: Seeker Arrow
levelGrants.description: Once per day as a standard action, launch an arrow at a known target within range. The arrow can travel around corners and ignores cover and concealment modifiers, though an unavoidable obstacle or the limit of the arrow's range stops it; otherwise resolve the attack normally.

levelGrants.name: Enhance Arrow
levelGrants.description: Enhance Arrow improves to a +3 enhancement bonus.

levelGrants.name: Phase Arrow
levelGrants.description: Once per day as a standard action, launch an arrow in a straight path at a known target within range. It passes through nonmagical barriers and ignores cover, concealment, and armor modifiers; magical barriers such as wall of force or wall of fire still stop it, and the attack is otherwise resolved normally.

levelGrants.name: Enhance Arrow
levelGrants.description: Enhance Arrow improves to a +4 enhancement bonus.

levelGrants.name: Hail of Arrows
levelGrants.description: Once per day in place of regular attacks, fire one arrow at each target within range, up to one target per arcane archer class level. Each attack uses the archer's primary attack bonus, and each enemy can be targeted by only one arrow.

levelGrants.name: Enhance Arrow
levelGrants.description: Enhance Arrow improves to a +5 enhancement bonus.

levelGrants.name: Arrow of Death
levelGrants.description: Create an arrow of death in one day. A creature damaged by it must succeed on a DC 20 Fortitude save or be slain immediately. The arrow functions only for its creator, lasts no longer than one year, and the arcane archer can have only one arrow of death in existence at a time.

classes/dwarven-defender-385.name: Dwarven Defender
classes/dwarven-defender-385.proficiencyText: A dwarven defender is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, all types of armor, and shields.

proficiencyReview.note: Exact Dungeon Master's Guide v.3.5 training grant verified against the class feature text.

defensiveStance.movementRestriction: cannot move from the defended spot until Mobile Defense

levelGrants.name: AC Bonus
levelGrants.description: Gain a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class at 1st level. The class AC bonus improves to +2 at 4th level, +3 at 7th level, and +4 at 10th level.

levelGrants.name: Defensive Stance
levelGrants.description: Enter a defensive stance during your own action, gaining +2 Strength, +4 Constitution, +2 resistance on all saves, and +4 dodge AC while unable to leave the defended spot. The Constitution increase adds 2 hit points per character level while the stance lasts. The stance lasts 3 + the improved Constitution modifier rounds and can be ended early; when it ends, you are winded and take -2 Strength for the rest of the encounter. Daily uses increase from 1/day at 1st level to 2/day at 3rd, 3/day at 5th, 4/day at 7th, and 5/day at 9th.

levelGrants.name: Uncanny Dodge
levelGrants.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to AC when flat-footed or attacked by an invisible opponent unless immobilized. If another class already grants uncanny dodge, the combined interaction grants improved uncanny dodge instead.

levelGrants.name: AC Bonus
levelGrants.description: The class dodge bonus to Armor Class improves to +2.

levelGrants.name: Trap Sense
levelGrants.description: Gain +1 on Reflex saves against traps and +1 dodge AC against trap attacks. Both bonuses improve to +2 at 8th level and stack with trap sense bonuses from other classes.

levelGrants.name: Damage Reduction
levelGrants.description: Gain damage reduction 3/-. At 10th level this improves to 6/-. Damage reduction can reduce damage to 0 but not below 0.

levelGrants.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
levelGrants.description: You can no longer be flanked except by a rogue at least four levels higher than your effective level for this ability. Levels from classes granting uncanny dodge stack to determine that effective level.

levelGrants.name: AC Bonus
levelGrants.description: The class dodge bonus to Armor Class improves to +3.

levelGrants.name: Mobile Defense
levelGrants.description: While maintaining Defensive Stance, take one 5-foot step each round without losing the stance's benefits.

levelGrants.name: Trap Sense
levelGrants.description: Trap Sense improves to +2 on Reflex saves against traps and +2 dodge AC against trap attacks.

levelGrants.name: AC Bonus
levelGrants.description: The class dodge bonus to Armor Class improves to +4.

levelGrants.name: Damage Reduction
levelGrants.description: Damage Reduction improves to 6/-.

classes/duelist-384.name: Duelist
classes/duelist-384.proficiencyText: A duelist is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, but gains no armor or shield proficiency.

proficiencyReview.note: Dungeon Master's Guide v.3.5 weapon proficiencies and explicit lack of armor/shield proficiency reviewed.

levelGrants.name: Canny Defense
levelGrants.description: While wearing no armor, using no shield, and wielding a melee weapon, add Intelligence bonus to the Dexterity-based Armor Class modifier, limited to one point of Intelligence bonus per duelist class level. Losing the Dexterity bonus to AC also removes this benefit.

levelGrants.name: Improved Reaction
levelGrants.description: Gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks; this improves to +4 at 8th level and stacks with Improved Initiative.

levelGrants.name: Enhanced Mobility
levelGrants.description: While wearing no armor and using no shield, gain an additional +4 AC against attacks of opportunity caused by movement out of a threatened square.

levelGrants.name: Grace
levelGrants.description: While wearing no armor and using no shield, gain a +2 competence bonus on Reflex saving throws.

levelGrants.name: Precise Strike
levelGrants.description: With a light or one-handed piercing weapon, deal +1d6 precision damage when not attacking with a weapon in the other hand and not using a shield. The target must be a living creature with discernible anatomy and vulnerable to critical hits. The extra damage improves to +2d6 at 10th level.

levelGrants.name: Acrobatic Charge
levelGrants.description: Charge through difficult terrain or other terrain that would normally prevent a charge, making any appropriate movement checks required by the obstacle.

levelGrants.name: Elaborate Parry
levelGrants.description: When fighting defensively or using total defense in melee combat, gain an additional +1 dodge bonus to AC for each duelist class level.

levelGrants.name: Improved Reaction
levelGrants.description: Improved Reaction increases to a +4 bonus on initiative checks.

levelGrants.name: Deflect Arrows
levelGrants.description: Gain the benefit of Deflect Arrows while using a light or one-handed piercing weapon.

levelGrants.name: Precise Strike
levelGrants.description: Precise Strike extra damage improves to +2d6.

classes/dread-commando-527.name: Dread Commando
classes/dread-commando-527.proficiencyText: Dread Commando grants no new weapon or armor proficiency; Armored Ease applies only to armor in which the character is already proficient.

proficiencyReview.note: Heroes of Battle class feature review confirms no new training grant; Armored Ease explicitly refers to armor with which the character is already proficient.

levelGrants.name: Sudden Strike
levelGrants.description: Deal +1d6 damage when the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sudden strikes require the target within 30 feet, and the target must have discernible anatomy and be vulnerable to critical-hit extra damage. The bonus becomes +2d6 at 3rd level and +3d6 at 5th level.

levelGrants.name: Team Initiative Bonus
levelGrants.description: The dread commando and allies within 30 feet who can see the dread commando gain a competence bonus on initiative checks equal to the dread commando class level.

levelGrants.name: Armored Ease
levelGrants.description: Reduce the armor check penalty of armor with which the dread commando is proficient by 2, to a minimum of 0. At 4th level the reduction becomes 4.

levelGrants.name: Sudden Strike
levelGrants.description: Sudden Strike increases to +2d6 damage.

levelGrants.name: Armored Ease
levelGrants.description: Armored Ease reduces the armor check penalty by 4, to a minimum of 0.

levelGrants.name: Stealthy Movement
levelGrants.description: Take no Hide or Move Silently penalty while moving up to normal speed, and only a -10 penalty while running or charging instead of the normal -20.

levelGrants.name: Sudden Strike
levelGrants.description: Sudden Strike increases to +3d6 damage.

classes/ghost-faced-killer-186.name: Ghost-faced Killer
classes/ghost-faced-killer-186.proficiencyText: Ghost-faced killers are proficient with all simple and martial weapons and with light armor.

proficiencyReview.note: Complete Adventurer p.51 training grant reviewed against the exact class feature text.

frightfulAttack.targetSaveDC: 10 + ghost-faced killer class level + Charisma modifier
frightfulAttack.success: shaken for 1 round per ghost-faced killer class level
frightfulAttack.witnessDuration: 1 round per ghost-faced killer class level

levelGrants.name: Ghost Step
levelGrants.description: As a swift action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity, become invisible for 1 round. Uses are 1/day at 1st level, 2/day at 4th, 3/day at 7th, and 4/day at 10th. From 6th level onward the same activation can instead make the ghost-faced killer ethereal for the round.

levelGrants.name: Sudden Strike
levelGrants.description: Deal +1d6 precision damage when the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. The bonus improves to +2d6 at 5th level and +3d6 at 8th level, following the ninja sudden strike restrictions.

levelGrants.name: Frightful Attack
levelGrants.description: Designate a melee sudden strike made with Power Attack and at least a -1 attack penalty as frightful. A damaged victim makes a Will save at DC 10 + ghost-faced killer class level + Charisma modifier; success leaves it shaken for one round per class level and failure slays it from fear. Eligible onlookers within 30 feet are also subject to the class's panic-or-shaken fear effect. Uses are 1/day at 3rd, 2/day at 6th, and 3/day at 9th.

levelGrants.name: Ghost Step
levelGrants.description: Ghost Step increases to 2/day.

levelGrants.name: Sudden Strike
levelGrants.description: Sudden Strike increases to +2d6 damage.

levelGrants.name: Frightful Attack
levelGrants.description: Frightful Attack increases to 2/day.

levelGrants.name: Ghost Step
levelGrants.description: Ghost Step can now make the ghost-faced killer ethereal for 1 round instead of invisible.

levelGrants.name: Ghost Sight
levelGrants.description: See ethereal and invisible creatures and objects as easily as material creatures and objects.

levelGrants.name: Ghost Step
levelGrants.description: Ghost Step increases to 3/day.

levelGrants.name: Sudden Strike
levelGrants.description: Sudden Strike increases to +3d6 damage.

levelGrants.name: Frightful Attack
levelGrants.description: Frightful Attack increases to 3/day.

levelGrants.name: Frightful Cleave
levelGrants.description: When a frightful attack slays its target, immediately make one extra melee attack against another target within reach. If that target is flat-footed, the extra attack also carries the frightful attack effect without consuming another daily use.

levelGrants.name: Ghost Step
levelGrants.description: Ghost Step increases to 4/day.

classes/warchief-581.name: Warchief
prerequisites: Special:Must have led a tribe in battle.
classes/warchief-581.proficiencyText: Warchiefs gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

proficiencyReview.note: Miniatures Handbook p.24 explicitly grants no weapon or armor proficiency.

devotedBodyguards.trigger: warchief is hit by an attack
devotedBodyguards.target: adjacent tribe member able to act
devotedBodyguards.effect: redirect the hit to the bodyguard regardless of Armor Class or other defensive effects

levelGrants.name: Tribal Frenzy
levelGrants.description: As a standard action, begin a tribal frenzy and maintain it as a free action each turn. Same-race, same-tribe allies that start their turns within 30 feet and can hear the warchief gain +2 Strength; the warchief is not affected. Each affected ally takes 1 point of damage per Hit Die at the start of each turn. The Strength bonus improves to +4 at 3rd level, +6 at 5th, +8 at 7th, and +10 at 9th.

levelGrants.name: Ability Boost
levelGrants.description: Charisma increases by +2 at 2nd level, by another +2 at 6th level, and by another +2 at 10th level, for a total +6 Charisma by 10th level. These increases stack.

levelGrants.name: Tribal Frenzy
levelGrants.description: Tribal Frenzy's Strength bonus improves to +4.

levelGrants.name: Tribal Frenzy
levelGrants.description: Tribal Frenzy's Strength bonus improves to +6.

levelGrants.name: Ability Boost
levelGrants.description: The cumulative Charisma increase becomes +4.

levelGrants.name: Tribal Frenzy
levelGrants.description: Tribal Frenzy's Strength bonus improves to +8.

levelGrants.name: Devoted Bodyguards
levelGrants.description: Once per round when an attack hits the warchief, a DC 15 Reflex save can redirect that hit to an adjacent tribe member able to act. The redirected attack is treated as hitting the bodyguard regardless of the bodyguard's Armor Class or other defensive effects.

levelGrants.name: Tribal Frenzy
levelGrants.description: Tribal Frenzy's Strength bonus improves to +10.

levelGrants.name: Ability Boost
levelGrants.description: The cumulative Charisma increase becomes +6 Charisma.
